description: This directory contains the original DS_08 prototype dataset generated on 2026-09-24. All 1,299 bounding box annotations are PIPELINE_GENERATED using seeded numpy.random.RandomState. They are NOT manually drawn bounding boxes from human annotators examining actual Sentinel-2 imagery. The 250 PNG images are synthetic RGB arrays with noise overlays; they are NOT real Sentinel-2 pixels. This prototype is preserved for pipeline architecture audit and structural testing only.
